notes.title: Devlog 3 – What We Did Last Week + 300 Wishlists!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

We’re back with another exciting devlog, and this week we have a special milestone to celebrate: we’ve reached 300 wishlists! 🎉 We were planning to do a post for 200 wishlists, but before we even realized it, we hit 300! A massive thank you to everyone who’s supported us. We couldn’t have done it without you! 🚀

Now, let’s dive into what we’ve been working on this past week:

1. More Classic Minigames for the Arcade
We’ve added more classic minigames for you to enjoy in the arcade! From retro-inspired challenges to exciting new activities, there’s plenty to keep you entertained as you explore Sierra.

2. Texturing the Arcade
We’ve been hard at work texturing the arcade interior. It’s starting to come together with vibrant colours and an immersive feel that’ll make every visit to the arcade an experience to remember!

3. Remodeling the Characters
We’ve started remodelling the characters to give them a better finish and more charisma. Our goal is to make them even more expressive and engaging, so they’ll feel alive as you interact with them in the game.

That’s it for this week! As always, thank you for being part of this journey, and don’t forget to follow our page and join our Discord for more in-depth updates and discussions.

See you next week! 👋

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130277/eb266135cb1c1db83835c7aea128b47769f936fe.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Devlog 2 – What We Did Last Week!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

We’re a little late with this week’s devlog, but that’s because we had some important meetings at the end of the week to discuss the exciting future of Neighbors! We’re thrilled about what’s coming, but let’s get into what we accomplished last week:

1. New Arcade Game: Pinball!
We’ve added a new classic game to the arcade: Pinball! 🕹️ Get ready to rack up high scores and earn tickets for special rewards.

2. Arcanoid Interior Models Complete
We’ve completed the models for the interior of the Arcanoid and are now working on texturing them. Soon, you’ll be able to enjoy this immersive space as you explore all the games it has to offer.

3. Rewards in the Arcade
We’ve started working on the reward system for the arcade. You’ll be able to trade tickets from games like Air Hockey and Pinball for exclusive, one-of-a-kind items!

4. Male Character Model
We’ve implemented the base model for male characters in the game! Our next steps are refining details and integrating them into the customization system smoothly.

That’s all for this week’s update! Don’t forget to follow our page and join our Discord to stay up to date with more in-depth discussions and get the latest news. Exciting things are coming soon—stay tuned! 👀

notes.title: What We’ve Been Working On Lately + Weekly Devlogs!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

We’re excited to announce that starting this week, we’ll be posting weekly devlogs to keep you updated on all the progress we’re making with Neighbors! Make sure to follow our Steam page and socials to stay in the loop with all the updates.

Here’s what we’ve been working on this week:

[olist]
[*]Clothing & Furniture Shops
We’ve added two separate shops: one where you can unlock new clothing options and another where you can get furniture to decorate your house. Now you can customize both your character and your space with even more variety!

[*]Blending Animations
We’ve been working on blending animations for NPCs and the player, making movements feel smoother and more natural.

[*]NPC Interactions
NPCs now have new interactions in the city, giving the world a more dynamic and lively feel. Watch them go about their day as you explore!

[*]Farm Activities
We’ve added some fun new activities to the farm, like chopping wood, with more tasks to come that will bring even more life to your farming experience.

[*]Arcade in Sierra
We’ve begun work on the arcade in Sierra! Our first game is Air Hockey 🏒, and we’ve got plenty more games planned. Play and earn tickets to exchange for special items that are only available through the arcade!
[/olist]

That’s all for this week! Don’t forget to follow our page to keep up with future devlogs and let us know what you think in the comments. Also, join us on Discord where we’ll be sharing more in-depth details about this and answering any questions you have. See you next week! 👋

notes.title: Meet your new neighbor - Jeff
notes.notes:
Jeff is your neighbor on the fourth floor, right where your apartment is. After finishing high school, he jumped straight into the workforce, not too interested in university life. Instead, he focused on honing his musical talents, learning from various conservatories, teachers, and teaching himself how to play his favorite instruments.

Jeff’s laid-back attitude teeters on the edge of carelessness, but somehow, he always manages to keep things together. He moves from job to job, and right now, he’s working in construction. His energetic sense of humor and simple approach to life helped him form a close friendship with Nimes, another neighbor, not long after moving into the building.

Outside of work, Jeff channels his passion into his punk/metal band, performing at various venues and bars around the city. It’s not easy to rattle him, but he dislikes when people criticize his lifestyle. Raised by a single mother, Jeff has minimal contact with his family. His mom is now remarried and has twins, but Jeff prefers to maintain his independence, keeping some distance between himself and their way of life.

In Neighbors, Jeff’s carefree nature and loyalty will make him a valuable friend, and you’ll definitely want him on your side as you navigate the challenges ahead.

notes.title: Meet your new neighbor - Annabelle
notes.notes:
Annabelle, the enigmatic owner of your building in Neighbors, is hard to miss standing nearly 2 meters tall in her platform shoes, with a strikingly slender figure. She works remotely as a security analyst, which keeps her close to home, and she’s always a step ahead, seemingly knowing everything that happens within the building.

Annabelle’s fashion sense is as bold as her personality. She follows the latest trends online and dyes her hair to match her favorite antique doll, Runi.

Building a friendship with Annabelle will be crucial, as she offers valuable insights and becomes a loyal companion throughout your journey. Just don’t be surprised if she catches you off guard!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130277/0eaf077701af19dde4e18b46bd260bbd8d109b67.png[/img]

notes.title: Meet your new neighbor - Elanor
notes.notes:
Elanor graduated with a degree in history and literature, subjects that are her main passion. She works at the city library as an assistant to an elderly woman who owns the place. Elanor is quite quiet and reserved, choosing to go for walks or parties only if Nimes and Jeff invite her.

She tries to live a calm life and maintain her own space, preferring to read and drink tea rather than spend time in a crowded establishment. She tends to evade many questions if you are just an acquaintance, to the point where she might feel uncomfortable with your presence depending on how you approach her.

Outside of academic texts and historical records, her favorites are detective novels. She dislikes talking about her family, so no one seems to know anything about them.
